question_en:
I am arranging animated short films as warm-up content for a community center and need to process all works in the image. Please answer:

Identify all works in the image and confirm whether they are completed and their official final runtime. After excluding works that are not yet completed and do not have a stable final runtime, classify the remaining works into one of the following scheduling categories according to these rules: works with a final runtime of no more than 8 minutes belong to "Single Segment Warm-up," and those exceeding 8 minutes belong to "Independent Screening." Please provide a complete list covering all works in the image, stating the work title, completion status, final runtime, and scheduling category for each row (indicating the reason for excluded works), and separately count the number of works in each of the two scheduling categories.

The answer must use a table to list the title, completion status, final runtime, and scheduling category (with reasons noted for excluded works) of all works, followed by the counts for the two scheduling categories after the table.
